note: Eden-style courses remodel. No rules change. Appended, never substituted: earlier digests for these files stay recorded under their own tickets.

entries.why: The own-courses list becomes the product cards in courses/CourseProductList, New course opens the shared product-type picker and then the CourseWizard instead of AdminCourseEditor, and the row type is ProductCourse. NOTHING ELSE MOVED: the by-id adoption reads (THE-342), the counted slots and dangling-adoption notice (THE-345), the maxCourses gate, the adopt analytics event (THE-361), the library tab and the read-failure and truncation alerts are byte-for-byte what they were.

The member overview and lesson screens become the course landing page and the Eden-style player, and the library list now shows only courses the member may open, decided by lib/courses/access (canAccessCourse). Every read, bound and truncation notice from THE-342 is unchanged, as is the adopted-course resolution; the author screen is dropped because nothing links to it any more.

#543 appends eight course components to RECORDED_ADOPTERS, each with a ticket and a reason of more than 80 characters, because they adopt alert-family primitives the register tracks (empty, popover, radio-group, scroll-area, switch and textarea). Nothing already recorded was replaced or reworded.

Review fix round 1 on #543. Staff detection moves out of the component into isCourseStaff in lib/courses/access, so the member course list reads the same definition; the rule itself is unchanged (admin, super_admin or permissions.createCourses). The deep-link player gate and every read are untouched, and the earlier digest stays recorded because the earlier head stays a valid state of this file.

Merge of main (#540 settings popup) into #543. Both PRs append entries to RECORDED_ADOPTERS in this file, so the merged file matches neither PR's recorded digest. This records the merged content; both sets of appended adopters are present and nothing already recorded was removed or reworded. The earlier #543 digest stays recorded because that head was a valid state of the file.

Review fix round 2 on #543. The member Courses back button is lifted into one `coursesBack` element and also rendered above the locked-lesson landing, so a member who deep-links into a lesson they cannot open has a way back to the Courses list. The gate itself (accessFor(...).allowed before CoursePlayer), every read and the staff rule are untouched; the earlier digests stay recorded because earlier heads stay valid states of this file.

Merge of main (#544) into #543. #543 does not touch this file; it is byte-identical to origin/main at 20a3a0b, but the digest #544 recorded for it (8abdc8b8) does not match what landed on main, so THE-322's register fails on main itself and therefore on any branch that merges it. This records main's actual content so #543's guard run is green; nothing already recorded was removed or reworded.

Review fix round 3 on #543 (Bugbot: staff access decided before the user loads). The page now holds its spinner until the user document has also been read, or there is no signed-in user, so a course manager never sees a locked landing or a library that hides restricted courses before isCourseStaff has run. The gate itself, every read and the staff rule are untouched; the earlier digests stay recorded because earlier heads stay valid states of this file.
